summary: You have a readable preliminary design that covers all mission areas with STK evidence and a clear Australian-benefit rationale. To move from Adequate to Accomplished in the main body, you need quantitative support for launch, orbit, communications and EOL, plus complete software files and referencing. Your Introduction is strong; your Conclusion and presentation need more specific, evidence-linked detail.
next_steps: Add quantitative design evidence: launch performance/azimuth for direct SSO injection, swath/resolution derivation for 600 km, link budget/data volume, drag area/lifetime/casualty risk, and include your STK files.

Correct and support orbit and ground-station claims: calculate RAAN/J2 effects, replace or justify Mt Pleasant as an EO downlink, extend access analysis beyond three days, and remove the 'constant' contact claim.

Fix referencing and presentation: number and caption all figures/tables, add missing references [49]-[55] and [66]-[74], replace bare URLs and Wikipedia with proper citations, and clarify operator/users and EOL conclusions.

criteria.C1: Your Introduction clearly explains the reef-monitoring mission, Australian benefit, single-spacecraft rationale and likely users, with references. To secure a higher Accomplished mark, name the operator explicitly and define customer/funding roles more precisely; the rubric requires detailed descriptions and appropriate literature throughout.
criteria.C2: You cover launch, orbit, ground control, communications, duration and EOL with STK screenshots and an access table. The next level requires quantitative evidence: launch performance/azimuth for direct SSO injection, swath/resolution derivation for 600 km, link budget/data volume, drag area/lifetime/casualty risk, and STK files. Correct the contradictory resolution statement and RAAN/J2 claim, and replace the unbuilt Vega E or justify it with performance data.
criteria.C3: Your Conclusion restates the main design choices and links to the body, but it is brief and partly generic. To reach Accomplished, draw specific evidence-based conclusions for each design area, including EOL, and remove the inaccurate claim that Mt Pleasant gives constant contact; the access results show limited passes over three days.
criteria.C4: Your headings and structure are clear, but presentation is not yet professional. Number and caption every figure/table, including Image 4 and the access summary, add missing references [49]-[55] and [66]-[74], replace bare URLs and Wikipedia with proper citations, and fix typos/contradictions. Accomplished requires consistent formatting, an executive summary and in-text/reference-list matching.
